content.short: SlashToken is a tool for batch transferring tokens and NFTs to multiple wallets.
content.description: SlashToken enables batch transactions of tokens and NFTs, delivering fast, cost-effective distribution to many wallets at once. Ideal for blockchain and DeFi projects, it supports efficient community engagement and marketing programs. Transparent pricing makes large-scale giveaways practical: sending to 500 wallet addresses costs just 0.015 ETH on Ethereum or 0.1 BNB on Binance Smart Chain, opening airdrops to projects of all sizes and encouraging affordable, broad participation.
content.meta: SlashToken enables batch transactions of tokens and NFTs to wallets quickly. Discover SlashToken and other Web3 Developer Tools on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
